system.description:
You condense a rampaging ball of wind before throwing it, causing it to explode. Make a ranged ninjutsu (or taijutsu) attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 8d6 wind damage. Hit or miss, each creature within 15 feet of the target, excluding the original target, must make a Constitution saving throw or take 4d6 wind damage and becoming Dazed.

Critical Success: Affected creatures take half of 4d6 wind damage.

Success: Affected creatures take half of 4d6 wind damage and are Dazzled.

Failure: Affected creatures take 4d6 wind damage are Dazed.

Critical Failure: Affected creatures take the same damage as the original target and are Dazed.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and damage by 1d6.
